environment.description: ECS Fargate cluster with App Mesh integration and Istio control plane. Envoy sidecars enforce STRICT mTLS between all services. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the mesh level with a 'deny' action for source principals not matching 'cluster.local/ns/admin-namespace/sa/*'. However, the policy uses a custom 'when' condition checking request.headers[x-source-namespace] which is populated by a Lua filter in the EnvoyFilter resource (mesh-wide) that extracts namespace from the validated SPIFFE URI in the peer certificate. The Lua filter runs at the AUTHN phase before the AUTHZ phase. Additionally, the ECS task definition has a read-only root filesystem and drops all Linux capabilities except NET_BIND_SERVICE. The task IAM role has a permission boundary (AdminProxyBoundary) that includes a Deny statement for ecs:* when aws:RequestedRegion is not 'us-east-1', though the cluster operates in us-east-1.

envoy_filter.name: namespace-extraction-lua
envoy_filter.description: Extracts namespace from validated SPIFFE peer cert URI, sets x-source-namespace header

config.network_policy: awsvpc with security group allowing only mesh traffic on port 15006/15001
